title: Analyst Response Schema
description: Schema for Analyst [Business Analyst] (Atlas) structured response back to ULTRON. Contains research reports, insights, recommendations, competitor analysis, and market data.

agent.description: Agent identifier — always 'analyst' for this response schema

status.description: Overall status of the Analyst's work. 'success' = mission completed fully, 'partial' = completed with caveats or incomplete data, 'error' = could not complete.

summary.description: 1-2 sentence summary of what the Analyst produced. Used by ULTRON for consolidation.

artifacts.description: Concrete outputs produced by the Analyst's research and analysis work

researchReport.description: Path of the research report file created (e.g. '~/.claude/aios/docs/research-saas-market.md'), null if no report was generated

finding.description: The factual finding or data point discovered

confidence.description: Confidence level of this insight based on source quality and corroboration

source.description: Source of the data (URL, report name, database, etc.)

implications.description: What this finding means for the project or decision at hand

insights.description: Key insights discovered during research, each with confidence level and source

action.description: Recommended action to take based on research findings

expectedImpact.description: Expected impact if this recommendation is followed

risks.description: Risks associated with following this recommendation

recommendations.description: Actionable recommendations derived from research findings

competitorAnalysis.description: Competitor analysis results. Null if competitor analysis was not part of the mission.

ourPosition.description: Our current competitive position relative to competitors

gaps.description: Gaps in our offering compared to competitors

opportunities.description: Market opportunities identified through competitive analysis

marketData.description: Market data collected during research. Null if market data was not part of the mission.

marketSize.description: Total addressable market size (e.g. '$12B global, $800M Brasil')

targetAudience.description: Target audience description based on research

issues.description: Issues or blockers encountered during the Analyst's work

metadata.description: Meta-information about the Analyst's work process

missionType.description: Type of mission the Analyst executed, derived from mission.description analysis

autoDecisions.description: Number of autonomous decisions made (documented as [AUTO-DECISION] in free text)

sourcesCount.description: Number of distinct sources consulted during research

confidenceDistribution.description: Distribution of confidence levels across insights

freeText.description: Optional free-text field for additional unstructured context (Phase 1 hybrid mode)

position.description: Agent's position in Deliberative Group Chat. Format: 'agree_with:{agent}', 'disagree', or 'propose:{alternative}'. Null when not participating in a group chat round.
